newsitem.title: USA: PennFirst Bancorp to buy Troy Hill.
newsitem.headline: PennFirst Bancorp to buy Troy Hill.

text.p: PennFirst Bancorp Inc and Troy Hill Bancorp Inc said on Monday they had executed a definitive merger agreement under which PennFirst will acquire Troy Hill in a transaction valued at $23.6 million.
Troy Hill shareholders will receive $21.15 in cash or in PennFirst common stock for each share of Troy Hill common, they said.
The agreement is subject to an overall requirement that 40 percent of the total outstanding Troy Hill common stock be exchanged for cash.
Troy Hill is to be merged into PennFirst. Troy Hill Federal Savings Bank will operate as a separate bank subsidiary of PennFirst for at least one year.
The merger is expected to be completed in the first quarter of 1997.

Once the deal is finalized, PennFirst would have about $790 million in consolidated assets and $62 million in consolidated stockholder equity. It would operate 11 offices in four Pennsylvania counties.
